question: Does an independent identity-initialized orthogonal frame before GELU add task-useful capacity beyond the already causal post-GELU rotations at the frozen 124M plain-cproj endpoint?
scientific_scope: causal task-conditioned endpoint optimization of one new structural coordinate family; not continued pretraining and not a deployable selection result

evidence_chain.task_conditioned_chart: The exact bilateral chart improved both registered validation seeds by about 0.0097 CE but recovered only 4.4 percent of the plain-cproj gap.
evidence_chain.causal_attribution: Post-GELU hidden rotation alone passed the 0.005 cross-seed rule; both rotations reproduced the full gain; scalar gains were null; no depth band passed independently.
evidence_chain.required_test: Keep the accepted post-GELU rotations fixed and add only an independent pre-GELU activation frame. This directly tests whether the missing degree of freedom is orientation across GELU rather than residual mixing or scalar norm.

inputs.bilateral_reference_state: accepted hidden_rotation and output_rotation in all 12 layers; identity hidden_gain and output_gain

new_structure.location: c_fc output before GELU in every layer
new_structure.weight_folding: h_prime = h R is executed as F.linear(x, R^T W); R is applied to W^T without materializing an O(hidden^2) matrix

optimization_protocol.updated_parameters: only the new pre-GELU frame coordinates in all 12 layers; checkpoint parameters, generated BlockFHT bases, and the accepted bilateral rotations are frozen
optimization_protocol.objective: next-token cross entropy on deterministic fresh train.bin windows
optimization_protocol.learning_rate_rationale: Reuse the safety-gated frozen-endpoint chart LR; do not perform a learning-rate sweep.

evaluation_protocol.data_split: val.bin only; no validation window participates in optimization
evaluation_protocol.selection: choose the registered update with lowest primary-seed CE; at that same update report confirmation and audit CE
evaluation_protocol.baseline: the step-0 accepted-rotations-only state under this exact three-seed protocol

decision_rule.positive_structural_capacity: the primary-selected nonzero update improves primary, confirmation, and audit CE by at least 0.005 versus step 0
decision_rule.optimization_only_signal: training CE improves but the three-seed validation rule does not pass
decision_rule.reject_pre_gelu_frame: the registered three-seed rule does not pass; do not promote the structure to from-scratch training
decision_rule.promotion_if_positive: run one causal-from-scratch 124M 0.5TPP comparison with the pre-GELU frame and fixed post-GELU rotations; no broader ladder before that control

performance_gate.measurement: same script, checkpoint/state inputs, model, folded frame, batch shape, accumulation, cache path, optimizer, and GPU as the scientific run
performance_gate.numerator: conventional 6N decoder-model FLOP estimate times measured tokens per second
performance_gate.denominator: same-GPU empirical BF16 tensor-core GEMM peak

stability_control.separation: this seed is distinct from all three scientific evaluation seeds

performance_gate.policy: foreground-poll the preflight; do not launch the scientific run unless both the immutable 20 percent MFU gate and separate-seed CE safety gate pass

required_artifacts: pre-GELU coordinate states at every registered evaluation update
